p.src: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

p.src: 1  LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

en: LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
u.src: 1  LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

p.src: 2  You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

en: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
u.src: 2  You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

p.src: 3  You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

en: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
u.src: 3  You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

p.src: 4  Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

en: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
u.src: 4  Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

p.src: 5  Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

en: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
u.src: 5  Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

p.src: 6  Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

en: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
u.src: 6  Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

p.src: 7  Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.

en: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.
u.src: 7  Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.

p.src: 8  I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

en: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
u.src: 8  I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

p.src: 9  Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

en: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
u.src: 9  Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

p.src: 10  Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

en: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
u.src: 10  Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

p.src: 11  Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

en: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
u.src: 11  Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

p.src: 12  Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

en: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
u.src: 12  Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

p.src: 13  Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

en: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
u.src: 13  Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
